Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

All automated production database snapshots must be retained in hot storage for 30 days. After 30 days, snapshot volumes must be archived to immutable cold storage with a retention guarantee of 7 years. Under no circumstances should site reliability engineers purge cold storage backups without written authorization from the chief information security officer. Furthermore, never delete test database tables during automated cleanup runs without confirming staging isolation.

In the event of primary datacenter catastrophic failure, secondary region database replicas must be promoted within 15 minutes. In addition, automated snapshot integrity checks must execute every midnight using checksum validation algorithms to detect bit rot. Cross-region replication synchronization between us-east and eu-west must maintain recovery point objectives under 10 minutes. Backup storage volumes must also be replicated across three independent geographic availability zones with automated integrity validation. In addition, verify that annual disaster recovery failover simulations simulate a complete datacenter black hole without data corruption.

The security team mandates that all encryption keys utilized for storage volume backups be rotated annually within our hardware security module. All backup encryption keys stored in key management service must utilize envelope encryption, requiring multi-party quorum authorization for key destruction. Air-gapped immutable backup storage pools must remain physically isolated from standard enterprise network routes to prevent lateral ransomware transmission. System operators must also verify that backup storage bucket access logs stream continuously to the security operations center and alert on any unauthorized read or write attempts within 60 seconds of occurrence. The disaster recovery coordinator must review cold storage inventory logs monthly to ensure immutable object locks remain active across all archives. Incident response commanders must execute semi-annual unannounced tabletop exercises simulating active ransomware corruption, and all cryptographic signature verification logs must stream to write-once-read-many immutable cloud logging buckets. The compliance audit committee requires that daily backup verification reports be cryptographically signed and published to our internal compliance dashboard before 9:00 AM UTC every morning. All database restoration drills must be documented in formal audit reports and submitted to the compliance director within 10 business days of completion. In addition, the chief information security officer must review annual third-party continuity audit certifications before approving enterprise disaster recovery budgets."}]
